title: Work Journal: Granola meetings arrive again after Granola renamed its listing tool, and a missing Granola tool shows a warning
summary: Granola renamed the tool the Work Journal run used to list a day's meetings, so meeting suggestions silently stopped. The run now uses search_meetings, denies the nine tools Granola added since, and checks the run's own tool list so a missing Granola tool shows one plain 'Maestro needs an update' line while the other suggestions keep arriving.
lessons_learned: A live check of Granola suggestions needs a day whose journal page does not already list the meetings: the first live run returned 0 meeting suggestions because the model rightly skipped meetings already on the page, which looks like the bug it was checking for.

deferred.what: The project's CLAUDE.md says the skip-count baseline is 0, but main carries one #[ignore] on mcp_settings::smoke_get_status_real_files, so every Rust run reports '1 ignored' and a dev or review agent may read that as a broken baseline
